title: The Mystery Hour Holiday Spectacular
seo_title: The Mystery Hour Holiday Spectacular in Springfield, MO
description: The Mystery Hour Holiday Spectacular is a live holiday comedy show hosted by Jeff Houghton, featuring music, comedy, and guest interviews, with Zack Ward (Scut Farkus in A Christmas Story) joining this year. The show is not televised and returns to the Gillioz Theatre, where The Mystery Hour was taped for 10 seasons. It takes place Friday, December 11, 2026 at 7:30 PM, with doors at 6:30 PM, at 325 Park Central, E Springfield, Missouri.
